sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/372 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: place 372, grids 537, 538, 539 and search/details for every unit, 2027-06-15; sample sites on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-06-19; grids for 2026-11-17 to 2027-04-27; read 2026-10-31)

values.note: Every RV site has electric: $39 a night; full hookups $52; premium electric sites $43; premium full-hookup sites $65. The same on a Saturday. Off-peak (November 2026 to March 2027) $35 on every type. The $29 sites are tent only. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 39.00, Full Hookup 52.00, Premium Electric 43.00, Premium Full Hookup 65.00, Tent Only 29.00, Fee 6.50); sites 001, 040, 053, 177 on Sat 2027-06-19 and on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16 (35.00), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/pymatuning-state-park-campground ('Full-hookup (30/50 amp), Electric (20/30 amp) and Non-electric sites') + ReserveOhio details (Electricity Hookup '20,30,50' on nearly every RV site; Sewer and Water Hookup on the full-hookup types), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 343 web-listed RV sites with pads 25-97 ft (97-ft sites 2-7 are the pull-throughs): 269 electric, 45 full hookup, 22 premium electric, 7 premium full hookup. Site 190's pad is 25 ft; every RV pad takes a 23-ft rig. 21 further sites (88-108) are tent only.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid and details (Pad Length 25-97; PullInTypeName Pull Through on sites in 001-087; Campsite Tent Only IsRVSite false), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Heated shower houses; fish cleaning station; a small beach for campers near the centre of the campground. North dump station stays open in winter, weather permitting, without water.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/pymatuning-state-park-campground ('Heated shower houses and flush restrooms'; 'Laundry facilities'; 'Campground store'; 'Fish cleaning station'; 'Small beach for campers'; 'The north dump station is available, weather permitting; no water is available.') + ReserveOhio details ('Distance to Drinking Water'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: In the winter camping season only sites 1-59 and 85-87 are available; full-service sites 40-59 have no water. Water at the frost-free hydrant by the basketball court; two heated family restrooms/showers by sites 21 and 22.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/pymatuning-state-park-campground ('Off-peak Season: During the winter camping season, sites #1 - #59 and sites #85 - #87 are available (full-service sites #40 - #59 do not have water)...') + ReserveOhio search/grid (537 sold through winter; 538 and 539 blocked to 2027-03-16), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Reservations required, up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio. A camp office is open May-November.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/pymatuning-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required and can be made online or by calling (866) 644-6727'; 'They can be reserved up to six months in advance') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-31

summary: Fees $39 + $13 full hookup confirmed; added premium rates and the $35 off-peak rate. Added 50-amp/W/S, 343 RV sites to 97 ft (pull-throughs), showers/flush/water/dump/laundry/store, year-round with winter site list, deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max. Lakefront stands. AWH note kept verbatim.

ODNR is milder: 'located near the lake; some sites offer water views'. No change proposed.
